summary: The article discusses the emergence of two new ETFs, the Unusual Whales Subversive Democratic Trading ETF (NANC) and the Unusual Whales Subversive Republican Trading ETF (CRUZ), which track the stock trades of members of Congress. title: Exclusive: Nvidia set to face French antitrust charges, sources say
summary: Nvidia is reportedly facing antitrust charges from the French antitrust regulator for alleged anti-competitive practices, making France the first enforcer to act against the computer chip maker. The charges follow dawn raids in the graphics cards sector last year and stem from a broader inquiry into cloud computing, with concerns raised about Nvidia's CUDA chip programming software and investments in AI-focused cloud service providers. Companies in France can face fines of up to 10% of their global annual turnover for antitrust breaches.

title: U.S. Complementary And Alternative Medicine Market Size to Hit USD 229.12 Bn by 2033
summary: The U.S. complementary and alternative medicine (CAM) market is projected to reach USD 229.12 billion by 2033, growing at a CAGR of 23.11% from USD 28.65 billion in 2023. This growth is driven by the rising prevalence of chronic diseases, increasing awareness and acceptance of holistic health approaches, improved accessibility and affordability of CAM therapies, and technological advancements. Traditional alternative medicine/botanicals dominated the market in 2023, while the mind healing and e-sales segments are expected to experience the fastest growth.

title: BlackRock’s Top Thematic Trends to Watch in 2H

title: Utility stocks are Wall Street’s secret backdoor to AI

Investors are realizing that these stocks offer an undervalued entry point into the AI sector as data centers expand and electrification increases power demand. Experts predict continued growth for utilities, supported by rising electricity rates, falling equipment costs, and potential interest rate reductions, despite potential risks like weaker-than-anticipated power demand growth or insufficient ROI from AI technologies.

title: Nvidia CEO Cashes in on Rally With $169 Million Share Sale
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang sold shares worth nearly $169 million in June, marking his largest monthly sale and his first of the year. summary: NVIDIA, once known primarily to gamers, recently became the world's most valuable company due to its CEO Jensen Huang's foresight in steering the company towards artificial intelligence two decades ago. The company's unique approach of designing specialized chips and developing crucial software like CUDA for 3D graphics and later AI applications created a significant competitive advantage. This strategic shift, particularly after a pivotal moment in 2012 when GPUs outperformed CPUs in AI image recognition, solidified NVIDIA's position and led to its immense success, despite high stock valuations.

summary: Waabi, a Toronto-based startup, is leveraging generative AI and NVIDIA technology to develop a fully driverless autonomous trucking solution. Their innovative approach combines a generative AI "teacher" (Waabi World simulator) with a "student" (Waabi Driver, an end-to-end AI system) to reduce the need for extensive on-road testing and accelerate commercial scaling. Waabi plans to launch fully driverless operations next year, aiming to transform the long-haul trucking sector with a safer and more capital-efficient solution.

title: What broadening rally? AI stocks dominate US market again in Q2
summary: AI stocks, particularly a select group of major tech companies, continued to dominate the US market rally in Q2 2024, contributing almost all of the Morningstar US Market Index's gains. Other sectors and smaller capitalization stocks either showed minimal gains or detracted from overall market performance, while some AI-adjacent companies like Intel and Salesforce experienced significant drops.

title: ‘Uberizing’ the Electric Grid
summary: Edison International's Pedro Pizarro and NVIDIA’s Jensen Huang discussed how AI will transform the electric power industry by enabling smart grids that balance supply and usage more flexibly. This shift, driven by a rapid increase in electricity demand due to AI and data centers, envisions a future where the grid operates much like ride-sharing apps, connecting power sources with consumer needs. This integration of AI is expected to improve efficiency, reliability, and the incorporation of clean energy.

Microchip aims to provide a comprehensive single-vendor solution across 8-, 16-, 32-, and 64-bit embedded processing, leveraging RISC-V architecture and advanced features for diverse industrial, automotive, IoT, and aerospace sectors.

title: AMD acquires language model developer Silo AI for $665M

This acquisition will integrate Silo AI's software portfolio and its 300-person machine learning team into AMD's Artificial Intelligence Group, aiming to enhance AMD's AI strategy, improve customer experience for processor buyers, and accelerate the development of open-source large language models.

This strategy allows the company to maintain high standards of customer privacy and compliance, achieve faster time to market, and leverage its extensive engineering talent. While public cloud is used for seasonal demand spikes, eBay believes its core competency for large-scale AI workloads is best served by its dedicated HPC infrastructure despite challenges like rapidly evolving GPU technology and power/cooling demands.

CoSAI will initially focus on three open-source workstreams: scanning for AI cybersecurity risks, mitigating those risks, and addressing software supply chain vulnerabilities related to AI.
